title: Minimum Operations to Transform Array into Alternating Prime
goal: Solve Minimum Operations to Transform Array into Alternating Prime: Classify index requirements, choose nearest allowed values, and accumulate independently optimal increments.
strategy: Classify index requirements, choose nearest allowed values, and accumulate independently optimal increments.

phasePurposes.classify: Even indices need prime; odd indices need non-prime.
phasePurposes.choose: Choose the first valid value reachable by increments.
phasePurposes.apply: Apply the exact value difference to this position.

edgeCases: Even indices require prime values and odd indices non-prime values; only increments are allowed, and one is non-prime.
inputRules: Enter 1–100,000 positive integers, each at most 100,000.
